worldScale.note: World positions are expressed in blocks by the game API. VintageRTX deliberately maps one block to one metre before evaluating SI equations; this is not claimed as an engine guarantee.

engineInputCalibration.note: GetWindSpeedAt exposes a vector but the public API does not specify SI units. This explicit conversion is therefore a renderer calibration, not a measured Vintage Story constant; the physical wave equations consume the converted m/s value.

iapws-water-ior-1997.title: Release on the Refractive Index of Ordinary Water Substance as a Function of Wavelength, Temperature and Pressure
iapws-water-ior-1997.note: Refractive index depends on wavelength, temperature and density; 589 nm is retained as the profile reference wavelength.

pope-fry-water-absorption-1997.title: Absorption spectrum (380-700 nm) of pure water. II. Integrating cavity measurements
pope-fry-water-absorption-1997.note: Napierian absorption coefficients measured for pure water near 22 C.

nasa-ocean-optics-pure-water-2003.title: Ocean Optics Protocols for Satellite Ocean Color Sensor Validation, Revision 4, Volume IV
nasa-ocean-optics-pure-water-2003.note: Reference table of pure-water absorption and molecular scattering coefficients. VintageRTX samples its 650, 550 and 450 nm rows for the linear-RGB spectral approximation.

cox-munk-water-slope-1954.title: Measurement of the Roughness of the Sea Surface from Photographs of the Sun's Glitter
cox-munk-water-slope-1954.note: For a clean water surface, total mean-square slope is 0.003 + 0.00512 W with wind W in m/s at 41 ft. VintageRTX uses only the wind-driven 0.00512 W increment, because a game lake has no guaranteed background ocean swell.

quan-fry-seawater-ior-1995.title: Empirical equation for the index of refraction of seawater
quan-fry-seawater-ior-1995.note: Index is a function of salinity, temperature and wavelength.

iapws-seawater-surface-2019.title: Guideline on the Surface Tension of Seawater
iapws-seawater-surface-2019.note: Surface tension correlation as a function of salinity and temperature.

tyowua-honey-2023.title: Influence of particle fluorination on the stability of honey foam
tyowua-honey-2023.note: At 30 C: density 1496 kg/m3, refractive index 1.481, viscosity 7.85 Pa s and surface tension 0.0801 N/m for the measured honey.

oroian-honey-2013.title: Measurement, prediction and correlation of density, viscosity, surface tension and ultrasonic velocity of different honey types at different temperatures
oroian-honey-2013.note: Supports temperature-dependent honey transport properties rather than a normalized viscosity slider.

aernouts-raw-milk-optics-2015.title: Visible and near-infrared bulk optical properties of raw milk
aernouts-raw-milk-optics-2015.note: Measured bulk absorption, scattering and anisotropy spectra; optical coefficients vary with fat, casein and globule size.

venkataswami-milk-surface-1961.title: Studies on surface tension of milk
venkataswami-milk-surface-1961.note: Mean cow milk surface tension 0.04755 N/m at 20 C across 30 samples.

orawan-oils-2017.title: Density, viscosity, and surface tension of five vegetable oils at elevated temperatures: Measurement and modeling
orawan-oils-2017.note: Measured density, dynamic viscosity and surface tension from 23 C to the smoke point for five edible oils.

liu-edible-oil-optics-2015.title: Optical properties of edible oils
liu-edible-oil-optics-2015.note: Measured refractive index and absorption from 300 to 2500 nm between 20 and 80 C.

nist-ethanol-viscosity-2023.title: Reference Correlation for the Viscosity of Ethanol from the Triple Point to 620 K and up to 102 MPa
nist-ethanol-viscosity-2023.note: Critically evaluated dynamic-viscosity correlation; mixtures must not reuse pure-ethanol values blindly.

goncalves-ethanol-2010.title: PVT, viscosity, and surface tension of ethanol: New measurements and literature data evaluation
goncalves-ethanol-2010.note: Measured density, viscosity and surface tension for high-purity ethanol over temperature and pressure ranges.

pioli-basalt-2012.title: Experimental constraints on the outgassing dynamics of basaltic magmas
pioli-basalt-2012.note: Representative basaltic magma: density about 2800 kg/m3, viscosity 1-100 Pa s, surface tension about 0.4 N/m.

brogi-magmafoam-2022.title: MagmaFOAM-1.0: a modular framework for the simulation of magmatic systems
brogi-magmafoam-2022.note: Confirms density, viscosity and surface tension as constitutive properties dependent on temperature, composition and phase distribution.

chevrel-basalt-emissivity-2022.title: High temperature spectral emissivity of glass and crystal-bearing basalts
chevrel-basalt-emissivity-2022.note: Thermal emission is based on temperature and spectral emissivity, not an arbitrary orange RGB multiplier.

raw-cow-milk-293k.note: Bulk optical coefficients must be selected from measured spectra according to fat/casein content; this scalar profile is not universal milk.

vegetable-oil-296k.note: The exact oil type should override this family representative through its own mod asset.

ethanol-water-293k.note: Game alcohol concentration is not published; density, viscosity, IOR and surface tension require mixture interpolation once concentration is known.

basaltic-melt-1473k.note: Visible emission must be computed from Planck radiance at the current temperature and spectral emissivity.

rapid-water.derivation: same material; flow changes geometry only

rivulet.derivation: same material; thin-film path length changes optics

boiling-water.derivation: temperature correction plus unresolved vapor scattering

slaked-lime-slurry.derivation: aqueous carrier plus measured-particle scattering required

plant-and-rendered-oil.derivation: oil-family representative; exact item may override

curd.derivation: dense multiphase material; liquid solver disabled

whey-curd.derivation: dense multiphase material; liquid solver disabled

cottage-cheese.derivation: dense multiphase material; liquid solver disabled

cider.derivation: aqueous carrier plus measured beverage spectrum required

raw-fruit-juice.derivation: aqueous carrier plus pulp scattering and pigment absorption

mineral-acid.derivation: solution identity and concentration required from supplying mod

aqueous-dye.derivation: Beer-Lambert solute spectrum required from supplying mod

pitch-glue.derivation: heavy-organic surrogate; supplying mod should override

tar.derivation: heavy-organic surrogate; supplying mod should override

weak-tannin.derivation: aqueous carrier plus concentration-dependent tannin absorption

strong-tannin.derivation: aqueous carrier plus concentration-dependent tannin absorption
